facts.text: Lehigh County is named after the Lehigh River, derived from a Lenape Indian term meaning where there are forks.
The Liberty Bell was hidden in a church basement in Allentown to protect it from the British Army in 1777.
Shelter House in Emmaus is the oldest continuously occupied structure in Lehigh County and among the oldest in the United States.
Lehigh County was a major center for heavy industry and manufacturing during the Industrial Revolution.
Lehigh County is located geographically between two Appalachian mountain ridges, Blue Mountain to the north and South Mountain to the south.
Notable residents of Lehigh County include Hall of Fame football players Chuck Bednarik and Andre Reed, and actress Amanda Seyfried.
